Players Committee card image of [[Walker Sighting (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Cancel Too Cold For Speeders. OR Unless opponent's AT-AT or AT-ST at a battleground site, retrieve 1 Force for each Rebel Base location you control (limit 3). OR Your Rebels and T-47s at sites where opponent has an AT-AT or AT-ST are power +2 for remainder of turn.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/walkersighting.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018).
